d:
Sonia Gandhi has shared a personal memory of her relationship with former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi at the launch of her memoir, 'Belonging: A Journey of Love'.
She revealed that she was initially terrified of Indira Gandhi and found it difficult to approach her.
Sonia said she was uncomfortable calling Indira 'Maa' or 'Mummy' because she had only one mother, her Italian mother.
She also recalled how Indira Gandhi's occasional anger reminded her of her father, making her freeze in fear.
